messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from yesterday's PM: we traced the cross-region retry spike to a shadow routing rule that was left enabled during the rollout. Root cause = rule mismatch + TTL drift on our DNS cache.
oz: Ugh. do we have the exact rule id? can you paste the config diff?
maya: Rule id `route-shadow-2026-03-22-7a` — it was intended for canary but matched a broader prefix. Patch attached in the git PR (link) but tl;dr: it forced traffic through region-a if backend health fuzzy => caused sticky retries to region-b when TLS handshake dropped.
harry: Actions I see from PM: 1) rollback shadow rule (maya) 2) add guard to route matcher (oz) 3) add alert on per-region retry-rate (leah) 4) TTL audit + sync with infra (ops-chris). timelines?
maya: Rolling back now (started). ETA 20m. will post status.
incidents-bot: ALERT auto-detect — Cross-region retry rate > 6% for lb-edge-prod (detected at 1923570200). See /alerts/AR1234
leah: I'll own the retry-rate alert. Proposed alert: trigger if 1m retry_rate > 3% AND p95 latency > 250ms. I'll put a draft in paging config and tag for review.
ops-chris: TTL audit — our edge cache TTLs were 300s in prod and some regions had local DNS resolving to 30s via infra override. I'll reconcile with zones. ETA EOD.
oz: Guard change: I'll update the route matcher to require explicit canary header `x-rw-canary: true` for shadow rules. Tests: added two unit tests and an e2e with `curl -H 'x-rw-canary:true'` to verify path.
maya: Rollback complete. traffic normalized in 5m. observed retry-rate drop from 7.2% -> 0.9% on the dashboard.
harry: Nice. action owners + timelines summary?
maya: - rollback rule: maya (done) - route matcher guard: oz (in review, ETA next deploy 1923571800) - alert: leah (drafted, will merge by EOD) - TTL audit + reconcile: ops-chris (EOD) - postmortem doc update: harry (I'll link findings + RCA by tomorrow)
leah: also adding a follow-up to track recurring pattern: when TLS handshake variance + odd route rules combine, we get this spike. I'll add a regression test in canary harness to simulate handshake timeouts.
harry: please add owners to the postmortem checklist so we can auto-check next 30d for recurrence.
maya: noted. I'll add a '30d recurrence check' and schedule a quick sync next Tue 10am.
oz: FYI logs to grab if anyone needs them: `kubectl logs -n lb-system --selector=app=edge-proxy | grep route-shadow-2026-03-22-7a` and `tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/handshake.pcap` for handshake repro.
ops-chris: Putting a conservative DNS TTL patch into infra pipeline to unify TTLs to 120s for edge resolvers — will monitor next 48h.
leah: :thumbsup:
harry: Great. Thanks team — filing the action item board now and will link to the postmortem doc. if anything slips, ping here.
maya: closing check-in. will reopen if we see another bump.
